title: NoBerryDamage
description: Take no damage from sweet berries
body:
# NoBerryDamage
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Prevents sweet berries from dealing damage when moving through them.   
- The purpose of this plugin is to simplify the game, improve safety of players. 
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
